title: [Blue] MilosPack
description: MilosPack! But blue! A pack so bright and beautiful
body:
This is a simple and safe .zip texture pack.

No scripts, no changes to game code—only textures.

Fully clean pack including:

• armor

• tools

• items

• UI

• blocks
